## Technical details

I believe the see-more variant is always the same colors as the default variant. Therefore there is no separate see-more. They only distinguish themselves by content.

All states (default, hover, active, focus) are implemented correctly.

The variant of the CategoryNode decides which flag-corners to use. The corners of the flag-prop must be ignored.

### molecule/CategoryNode/CategoryNodeBig.vue

Image is 1:1 on square. Rectangle are custom dimensions for desktop/mobile.

Some props:

* textPosition: inside, below
* textAlign: left, center
* href: element is linked
* media: optional Media
* colorMode: on-light, on-dark, on-bright
* imageSize: square, landscape, portrait
* flag: optional flag-props
* showOverlay: bool

No icon prop, no variant prop. For now.

For showOverlay true, see the playground with the image: dark variants. You may be able to use the LuiImageContrastOverlay component for this.

longDescription:
## Purpose

The CategoryNodeBig component provides a large-format category navigation element for prominent placement on entry pages and homepages. It offers visual impact through larger imagery and flexible text positioning options.

## Use Cases

- Create hero-style category navigation on homepages
- Display featured categories with high-impact imagery
- Use landscape format for wide banner-style category links
- Use portrait format for vertical category showcases
- Add promotional badges like "Sale" or "New" to highlight featured categories
- Apply gradient overlays to ensure text readability on varied imagery

## Design Rationale

The big variant prioritizes visual impact while maintaining flexibility. Three aspect ratio options accommodate different layout requirements and imagery. Text can be positioned on the image (with optional gradient overlay for contrast) or below for clean separation. The gradient opacity is adjustable to balance image visibility with text readability. Flag positioning uses themed padding to maintain visual harmony across different node configurations.
shortDescription: Ideal for hero-style category navigation on homepages and entry pages. Supports promotional badges like "Sale" or "New" with themed flag positioning. Full interaction states (default, hover, pressed, focus) provide clear feedback. Gradient opacity is adjustable to balance image visibility with text readability, and the component uses LuiImageContrastOverlay for dark image variants.
